drums.tags: Alternative rock with a heavy grunge influence. Distorted electric guitars play a repetitive, descending minor-key riff. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar riff with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums feature a steady backbeat with heavy compression on the snare and resonant, open hi-hats. A second electric guitar provides feedback swells and occasional dissonant lead lines. The arrangement maintains a consistent dynamic level throughout the excerpt. 120 BPM, 4/4 time signature, E minor.

bass.tags: Drum solo and percussion study. Features a standard five-piece acoustic drum kit with hi-hats, ride, and crash cymbals. The performance begins with a syncopated hi-hat and snare pattern before transitioning into a high-tempo rock beat at 140 BPM. The drummer utilizes rapid double-stroke rolls on the snare and toms, interspersed with heavy crash cymbal accents. The middle section features a rhythmic motif played on the cowbell and woodblock, accompanied by a steady kick drum pulse. The piece concludes with a series of complex polyrhythmic fills across the toms and a sustained cymbal swell. The recording has a dry, close-mic'd aesthetic with minimal room reverb.
